name: ECO Fund (Environment Community Otago Funding)
summary: Annual contestable grants from Otago Regional Council for community-led projects that protect, enhance or promote the environment in Otago, including biodiversity scaling-up, weed removal and revegetation. The 2026 round has closed.

amount.note: Maximum per project depends on funding category: up to $50,000 for the general category, $50,000 to $150,000 for scaling-up biodiversity

eligibility.rule: Project lasts no more than 3 years
Project aligns with the relevant funding category's objectives
Required management agreements or written permissions are in place before applying
Applicant has no outstanding or late report at the Assessment Panel meeting
Project engages or involves the community where required by its funding category
Project does not fund activities required by legislation, regulation, consent or compliance direction
Project is not for commercial or private gain

status.quote: Applications for the 2026 ECO Fund have closed

geography.quote: Project must be located in Otago.

access.quote: Applications for the 2026 ECO Fund have closed

window.quote: 16 March 2026: ECO Fund round opens 19 April 2026: ECO Fund round closes

amount.quote: $306,600 $50,000-$150,000 General (on-ground, education and projects enabling conservation) To protect and enhance Otago's environment. To enable community-led environmental activities. $306,600 Up to $50,000

eligibility.quote: Project must be located in Otago.
Project cannot be funded for more than 3 years in duration.
Project must align with the objectives of the relevant funding category
Management agreement(s) or relevant written permission(s) that allow the project to be completed on site must be in place before submitting your application.
Additionally, an applicant with an outstanding / late report as at the date of the Assessment Panel meeting will not be eligible to ECO Fund.
Projects must engage or involve the community
Activities required by legislation, regulation, consent conditions or compliance direction
Projects for commercial or private gain

documents.quote: For an application to be eligible, you must include a copy of the management agreements and/or written permissions that allow your project to take place on the project site.
one quote is required for expenses between $500 and $2,000 (excluding GST) two quotes are required for expenses exceeding $2,000 (excluding GST).

after_award.quote: Submitting progress reports (where applicable) and a final report on project outcomes to ORC within a specified timeframe, accounting for how funds were spent

documents: Management agreements or landowner written permissions
Supplier quotes for expenses over $500 (two over $2,000)
